versions.changelog:
Initial release of Puppeteer skill for browser automation.

- Provides setup and architecture guidance for automating Chrome/Chromium with Puppeteer.
- Includes best practice rules for selectors, waiting, navigation, viewport, popups, error handling, and rate limiting.
- Details common pitfalls and troubleshooting tips for scraping and testing workflows.
- Ensures local-only data storage for privacy and security.
- Lists related skills and ways to provide feedback.
